title: Rust: Recursion
description: Write recursive functions in Rust: factorial and fibonacci.

steps.title: Factorial Recursively
steps.description: Write a recursive function `factorial(n: u32) -> u32` that returns n!. Call with 5 and print.

steps.title: Fibonacci Recursively
steps.description: Write a recursive function `fib(n: u32) -> u32` that returns the nth Fibonacci number. Call with 7 and print.
hints: Base cases: `if n == 0 { 0 } else if n == 1 { 1 }`

steps.title: Sum of Digits
steps.description: Write a recursive function `sum_digits(n: u32) -> u32` that sums the digits of a number. Call with `1234` and print.

steps.title: Power Function
steps.description: Write a recursive function `power(base: i32, exp: u32) -> i32` that computes base^exp. Call with `power(2, 10)` and print.

steps.title: Count Down Recursively
steps.description: Write a recursive function `count_down(n: i32)` that prints n, then calls itself with n-1 until n reaches 0. Call with 5.
hints: Recursive case: print n, then call `count_down(n - 1)`

verification.failureMessage: Print numbers from 5 down to Done! using recursion.
